evals.name: review-and-fix-flagged-frames-only
evals.prompt:
The Metamorfiles project is at /path/to/project; pass that path to metamorfiles_get_project.

You are Studio's team on task t1, working on Serum launch (pages/serum-launch). Review and fix only these frames, which Studio's checks flagged; don't review or change any other frame:
- pages/serum-launch instagram-story (b): Text "Brighter skin in two weeks of daily use" is clipped by its box.
Render the frames you changed again until no check errors remain, then have the reviewer look at the frames you changed (the review skill) and fix each must fix once.

Follow the team skill (if this app didn't load it, call metamorfiles_get_guide with name "team" first): report every step with metamorfiles_team_update and task "t1", and ask choices with metamorfiles_ask_user. This task runs in Auto: metamorfiles_ask_user takes your recommended option.

For the final check, use the design-reviewer agent.

You're running in the background and the user is watching in the control panel: don't include its link.
evals.expected_output: The designer (or the copywriter first, when the words must change) fixes only the story frame of variant b, reporting each step; the design-reviewer agent then looks at that frame before the task ends; the summary says what changed and offers one next step.
assertions: Calls metamorfiles_team_update with task t1 before changing any file
Changes only pages/serum-launch instagram-story variant b
Changes no file for other variants or formats
Every metamorfiles_team_update line is a few words, starts with a verb and names no file or tool

Hands the final check to the design-reviewer agent, in the foreground, with only what the review skill's Run it, step 3, lists (the project path, the item and its changed frames, the task id, the brief, and the task's decisions and researched sources when there are any), never its design reasoning, before finishing
Fixes each must fix once, in the frame itself, and has it looked at again
Renders the changed frame again and leaves no check error
Ends each role with status done
The final summary is the agent's own, with no control panel link, hex value or pixel size, and ends on an offer, not a question

evals.name: copy-choice-asked-in-chat-mode
evals.prompt:
The Metamorfiles project is at /path/to/project; pass that path to metamorfiles_get_project.

You are Studio's team on task t2, working on Serum launch (pages/serum-launch). The user asked: Show me a few headline options for the story

Follow the team skill (if this app didn't load it, call metamorfiles_get_guide with name "team" first): report every step with metamorfiles_team_update and task "t2", and ask choices with metamorfiles_ask_user. This task runs in Chat: metamorfiles_ask_user asks the user, you end your turn, and their answer comes as your next message.

For the final check, use the design-reviewer agent.

You're running in the background and the user is watching in the control panel: don't include its link.
evals.expected_output: The copywriter offers two to four headline angles with metamorfiles_ask_user, one recommended, ends its turn when it returns asked, then writes the chosen one within maxLength, the designer re-fits the layout, and the design-reviewer agent looks at the changed frames before the task ends.
assertions: Calls metamorfiles_ask_user with 2 to 4 options and exactly one recommended
Options differ in angle, not only in wording
Ends its turn after metamorfiles_ask_user returns asked, without writing the options into the frames
The chosen headline fits the variable's maxLength
Introduces no claim, number or price that isn't in the brand or the page
Has the design-reviewer agent look at the changed frames before finishing
